halo_zone_def: within 15px of warm fire pixel (warm = R-G>=30, R-B>=40, R>=120)
removal_rule: opaque AND dist<=6 from warm core AND NOT warm AND NOT barrier AND min>=200 AND spread<=60; alpha only

left_deliberately.note: transition shading (y13-19, darker grey/tan) and head fur (y20-28, continuous with body) are design, not halo specks; yellow glow is fire design

note_bands: dist bands use integer bounds; 13 removal px have Euclidean distance in (3,4), counted in the <=6 total but in neither integer band
